Our promise

Six promises we put in writing.

If we ever break one, tell us and we'll make it right.

1. One agent, your choice

Your contact info goes to the one agent you pick. Not a list, not a call center.

2. Never sold, never shared

We don't sell or share your info with agents, lenders, title companies or anyone else.

3. Swap any time

Text "swap" to your Move Manager. We'll introduce the next agent on your shortlist.

4. Fees up front

You see each agent's typical fee and agreement terms before you meet.

5. Free, always

Agents' brokerages pay us a flat 25% referral fee from their commission when you close. Your price doesn't change.

6. No lender steering

We never accept payment from lenders, title or insurance companies, and we'll never pressure you to use anyone.
